notes: Album and track searches now show which track titles matched and carry the search context into album detail pages.
Album detail pages can add individual tracks or all verified album tracks to a chosen existing or newly created MusicVerse playlist.
Home playlist previews now reflect real saved playlists instead of sample names and invented counts.
Album cards stay inside MusicVerse, while Spotify actions hand off directly to the Spotify app without opening an automatic browser fallback tab.
